name: sharing-scarf-in-snow
image_purpose: Relationship lifestyle post and winter street story

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic candid winter street portrait of two approved adults sharing one scarf while walking through a snowy waterfront neighborhood.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult partners with ordinary natural features and slight smiles, cheeks flushed from cold. She wears a long dark wool coat, cream scarf, leather gloves, dark jeans, and simple boots. He wears a charcoal wool coat, knit sweater, dark jeans, and optional simple beanie. He adjusts the scarf around her neck as she looks up at him.
prompt.composition_elements: 9:16 eye-level medium portrait with imperfect candid crop, faces sharp, shared scarf centered, snow flurries softly blurred in foreground. Include snow-dusted pavement, parked cars, distant ferry lights, waterfront atmosphere, and no readable signage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Overcast winter daylight only, no flash, natural cool color, subtle halation on snow highlights, realistic fabric and skin texture, warmth inside cold mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, eye-level documentary framing, crisp natural sharpness, subtle 35mm grain, balanced exposure, photorealistic street-film still.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic candid vertical 9:16 winter street portrait of two approved adult partners walking through light snow and sharing one scarf. She wears a long dark wool coat, cream scarf, leather gloves, dark jeans, and simple boots; he wears a charcoal wool coat, knit sweater, dark jeans, and optional simple beanie. He adjusts the scarf around her neck while she looks up and smiles softly, cheeks flushed from cold. Eye-level 35mm documentary framing, faces sharp, snow flurries softly blurred in foreground, snow-dusted pavement, parked cars, distant ferry lights, overcast winter daylight, subtle snow halation, realistic fabric texture, gentle warmth inside cold.
